provenance_notes: Fine-tuned from braille_cell_lighting.pt (teammate's lighting-robust + Braille-free-negatives checkpoint, built on our camera-degradation work) with 39 additional hard-negative images (barcodes/QR codes, dense code/text, shop clutter -- see cell_detect/make_synthetic_negatives.py and the Non-braille images folder), same proven 12-image positive set, no other changes. Held-out test (pg-10/11): mAP50 0.926 vs 0.940 for the parent checkpoint (negligible difference). Full pipeline (detect+classify+reconstruct text, 6 Gold text pages): 89.9% letters-only vs 88.2% for the parent -- a real gain on 4 of 6 pages. Also confirmed clean on a real AiSee photo with background clutter (person, laptop, signage): 0 false positives, same as the parent. Conf threshold carried over from the parent (0.40) rather than independently re-swept -- a live-detection threshold sweep against Braille-free images (matching lighting_robust/'s own methodology) has not been done for this specific derived checkpoint.
flutter_notes: Preprocess: resize letterbox to 1280x1280, RGB, divide by 255. Postprocess: YOLO26 detection head, output already de-duplicated (end-to-end head) -- keep every row above conf_threshold (a page has many cells, unlike the fingertip model which only keeps the single best row). Box centers are the cell centroids.
